What to Expect
🏃
All paces welcome

Whether you run 5 min/km or 10 min/km — every pace has a place at Verve. We don't time, we don't judge.

💧
We've got you covered

Water, Tata Gluco, and bananas provided at runs whenever possible. You just need to show up.

₹0
Completely free

No membership fee. No event fee. No hidden costs. Verve is funded by sponsorships and the team's own pockets.

📍
Campus 3, KIIT

Most runs start from Campus 3. The WhatsApp group will tell you the exact meet-up point before each run.
